summary: Quince Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing completion on September 8, 2026 of the sale of subsidiary Quince Therapeutics SpA, its AIDE/eDSP intellectual property for Ataxia-Telangiectasia, and related machines and systems to Ayma Therapeutics for $450,000 cash. The filing also reports President Charles Ryan's separation that same date, with a $1,014,489.04 lump-sum severance (18 months salary, pro-rated 150% 2026 bonus, 18 months COBRA) subject to a general release. No board recommendation or advisor named; pro forma financials provided. Watch for remaining cash runway and pipeline strategy after this asset disposal.
